cases.input: A closed/fixed item has acceptance authority, criteria revision and evidence.
cases.expect: Outcome is accepted while native closed/fixed values remain.

cases.input: A closed/fixed item has no acceptance record.
cases.expect: Outcome may be done but must not be accepted.

cases.input: A closed item has source resolution Won't Do.
cases.expect: Outcome is cancelled and no delivered result is claimed.

cases.input: A declined item has no execution period.
cases.expect: Outcome is rejected and remains distinct from cancellation.

cases.input: The same source item revision is imported twice.
cases.expect: One task identity and one transition set remain; duplicate is audited and skipped.

cases.input: An older source revision arrives after a newer one.
cases.expect: The stale revision is rejected and current state is unchanged.

cases.input: Actual effort differs from the latest estimate.
cases.expect: Both remain separately resolvable; actual effort never overwrites estimate.
